title: Donate to Garden of Hope Foster Care this Holiday Season! Gift Drive Ages 10-17!🎄
description:
🎄Our amazing realtors Melissa Hauan and Caroline Alfaro have put together a #GiftDrive for kids ages 10-17 years old at #GardenofHope in #CentralTexas this Holiday Season. 😍They are accepting gifts now until December 13th! Some ideas are gift cards to fast food places, colognes, perfumes, hoodies, jackets, board games, art kits, craft sets, and anything anyone wants to donate for these ages. please tag anyone you know who may want to help this #Christmas ❤️
